notes: Timetable validity: winter timetable 7 September 2026 – 27 June 2027 (cover, p1).
Holidays (TATİL GÜNLERİ) = official and religious holidays (Resmi ve Dini bayram günleri); the SUNDAY timetable is applied on public holidays (p38).
Sailings may be cancelled, delayed or diverted due to weather, technical failures or authority orders; extra sailings may be added depending on demand (p38).
Şehir Hatları may change timetables without prior notice; check the website for current timetable (p38).
Ferries may depart before scheduled time when they reach full capacity (p38).
Kadıköy–Haliç line (p32) operates from the NEW Kadıköy (Kadıköy Yeni) pier.
İstinye–Çubuklu line (p37) operates from the existing car-ferry piers at İstinye and Çubuklu (not the regular passenger piers).
Children over 6 years old must pay a fare (p38). Baggage up to 30 kg free; oversized/overweight baggage charged (p38).
No transfer rules or Old/New Kadıköy pier notes found on pages 1-3 or 38-40 beyond the above; p2, p36, p39, p40 are promotional pages.
